title: What's new in Expense Agent: Overview
summary: This overview walks through what is new in Expense Agent for 2026 wave 2. It covers mileage rates per period and vehicle type, credit card statement upload with automatic reconciliation, AI-checked travel expense policies, and more approval options. It also covers travel requests that create an expense report per trip, a new mobile app in preview, VAT reclaim on expense reports, and withholding tax for employees. The speaker also gives the plan for new languages and worldwide availability starting in October. Each topic is a short overview, with separate sessions in the playlist for the details.

chapters.title: Refreshed web app, new languages and worldwide availability
Withholding tax for employees and wrap-up

features.name: Refreshed web app user experience
features.description: The demos in this launch edition show a refreshed web app user experience, which looks a bit different from before. The speaker says you can see what you can do there even before you start.

features.name: New languages for Expense Agent
features.description: Five languages are enabled today. Czech, Dutch, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian and Swedish will be added.
features.status_evidence_quote: now we will enable Czech, Dutch, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish language

features.name: Worldwide availability
features.description: Expense Agent will be enabled in all countries worldwide, starting in October. The rollout is gradual, over the next few months.
features.status_evidence_quote: But what is more important, from October we will enable worldwide availability
caveats: Not all countries will get it in October
Gradual enablement

features.name: Mileage rates per period
features.description: Mileage allowance can now be set up for several periods that you define yourself. The system picks the rate based on the expense date, and you can still use a single period.
caveats: A separate session covers mileage in detail

features.name: Mileage rates per vehicle type
features.description: You can define different mileage allowances for car, truck, SUV and motorcycle, combined with date ranges. This is a legal requirement in some countries. The simple model still works without any mileage rate setup.
caveats: Mileage rate setup is optional

features.name: Credit card statement upload (credit card feeds)
features.description: You can manually upload a credit card statement and the system processes it. The imported lines are kept as credit card feed records, so the original imports can be tracked.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will not be available from October, it will be available from December
caveats: This is the first release of credit card feeds
Available from December, not October
Captions say 2029.2, which is probably mangled

features.name: Automatic reconciliation of credit card records with expenses
features.description: After you confirm the import, the system reconciles card records with your expenses automatically. If no receipt exists yet, it creates an expense per card record, and you attach the receipt later. If you already scanned the receipt, it matches the existing expense.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will not be available from October, it will be available from December
caveats: An expense created from a card record cannot be submitted until a receipt is attached
prerequisites: Confirm that the credit card import is correct

features.name: AI-driven travel expense policies
features.description: You write expense policies in plain language per expense category, and the system checks uploaded receipts against them. Non-compliant or unclear items are flagged, for example a flight receipt with no travel class. The flag helps the approver, who can still approve.
caveats: Not a hard limit, an approver can approve a flagged expense
Can cause additional AI cost
A separate session covers it in detail
prerequisites: Enable policy compliance in the setup

features.name: Approval improvements
features.description: Approvals get an enhanced approval history and audit trail, interim approvers, approval limits and alternate delegate approvals. These come with a new approval for travel requests.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come gradually from October to December
caveats: Rolled out gradually from October to December
A separate session covers approvals

features.name: Travel requests with expense report per trip
features.description: An employee creates a travel request with budget, dates and justification, and sends it for approval. When the manager approves, an expense report for the trip is created automatically. Uploaded receipts for that trip are then assigned to it.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come gradually from October to December
caveats: A separate session covers travel requests
Described as brand new functionality

features.name: New Expense Agent mobile app
features.description: A new mobile app for iPhone and Android scans receipts, crops out the background automatically and uploads only the receipt. It also works offline: receipts scanned offline are processed once a connection is back.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is available right now in a preview. So, only for testing
caveats: Preview, for testing only
A separate session covers the mobile app

features.name: VAT reclaim on expense reports
features.description: The system collects VAT details from receipts and prepares an expense VAT specification per expense line, with multiple VAT rates per line possible. On posting it uses the normal VAT business and product posting groups, so GL and VAT entries are created. An accountant must review the result.
caveats: Not fully automated, an accountant must review and confirm
VAT is used only for your own country, not for receipts abroad
Some countries do not allow VAT claims through expense reports
prerequisites: Allow VAT reclaim in the Expense Agent setup
Set up expense categories and subcategories for VAT

features.name: Withholding tax for employees
features.description: Withholding tax, already available for vendors, is extended to employees on expense reports. It supports gross per net and a simple compound model. When you post an expense report above the configured threshold, withholding tax entries are created.
caveats: A separate session covers it in detail
prerequisites: Withholding business posting group assigned to employees
Withholding product posting group assigned to expense categories
